movement_profile.formation_and_space: Partnered social dance, originating in public halls and warehouses.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rooted in Montevidean milonga, habanera, tango, vals, and candombe rhythms.
music_profile.sound_description: A rich Río de la Plata soundscape driven by tango compositions, milonga accents, poetic vocal delivery, and underlying Afro-Uruguayan candombe rhythmic influences.
music_profile.vocal_style: Poetic tango lyrics, popularized by singers such as Julio Sosa and Malena Muyala.

teaching.rhythm: Accompanying musical forms include tango, milonga, vals, and candombe.
